metadata.cdx:contract:
== COMPLEX-DAG — joint operational map of MySpace++ + GentlyOS ==
Two halves communicate through one file: studio/docs/NOTES-FOR-INFERANCE.md This SVG visualizes WHAT each half owns + WHERE they interface.
OWNERSHIP COLOR cyan = MySpace++ (this half — Python/bash/Streamlit) yellow = GentlyOS (other half — Rust/.bb/crystal DAG) lime = shared (bridge files + taxonomy + .env)
STATUS PIP (corner of each node) green = implemented yellow = partial orange = stub gray = placeholder purple = remote (gently-owned; I can't inspect directly)
CROSS-BOUNDARY EDGES are dashed. Every node has data-owned-by + data-status + data-node-id attributes.
REGENERATE: python3 studio/tesseract/complex_dag.py
